scope: Offline UI prototype, Chrome browser, no backend or model claims

checks.name: Visible navigation
checks.detail: All 13 sidebar page buttons render their page

checks.name: Writing focus and evidence
checks.detail: Focus mode exits with Escape; dialog returns focus; source selects the exact passage without changing text

checks.name: Memory-assisted writing journey
checks.detail: Input → simulated proposal → 3 review decisions → append revised text → independent event confirmation; source-review flag remains separate

checks.name: Stale proposal and source guards
checks.detail: Editing revision disables old proposal adoption; removing a quoted passage disables source positioning

checks.name: Cancelled task
checks.detail: Cancelled simulated task does not reopen a completed proposal or modify manuscript

checks.name: Knowledge galaxy
checks.detail: Filters, search, selected detail, 14-object list, pointer rotation and reset

checks.name: Character time lens
checks.detail: Early/warehouse/future differ; Song Yao remains unconfirmed; person search works

checks.name: World revision and order separation
checks.detail: Editing rule marks review; moving a scene changes narrative order but keeps original story order

checks.name: Foreshadowing evidence
checks.detail: Changing planned window does not mark payoff; absent quote cannot be confirmed as payoff evidence

checks.name: Notes and search
checks.detail: Edits survive internal navigation; explicit conversion creates author setting; search finds note and object

checks.name: Checkpoint restoration
checks.detail: Compare, restore, and preserve newer draft as a separate checkpoint

checks.name: Preferences and failure states
checks.detail: Font/paper updates; five failure states; simulated conflict retains both drafts

checks.name: New work and isolation
checks.detail: New work has genuine empty views; unique scene and content; tide story remains separate

checks.name: Import/export and literal content
checks.detail: Paste preview/back/import works; HTML remains inert text; actual Markdown download only contains selected work manuscript

checks.name: Mobile primary actions
checks.detail: Drawer navigation, memory, scene switch, and Escape

checks.name: Canvas fallback
checks.detail: Unavailable 2D context gives 14 accessible object rows with source dialogs

checks.name: Galaxy label readability
checks.detail: Default object labels do not overlap at 1440/1024/390/320; mobile shows focused relations

checks.name: Runtime and network
checks.detail: No browser pageerror; no HTTP(S) requests
